subject: maths

concepts.title: Line Graph Data Difference
concepts.definition: A visual representation using line segments connecting plotted points to display changes in a continuous metric over measured intervals of time.
concepts.key_idea: Calculate the net change in recorded continuous values across two specific time instances.
question_patterns: find the difference between the sales in {value1} and {value2}
calculate the temperature change from {value1} to {value2}
what is the increase in height between {value1} and {value2}
determine the net change in value from {value1} to {value2}
compute how much the parameter changed between {value1} and {value2}

solution_steps.action: subtract initial value from final value
solution_steps.explain: subtract value1 from value2 to find the net change

concepts.title: Independent and Dependent Variables in Graphs
concepts.definition: In a relationship between two quantities, the variable that is altered independently is placed on the horizontal axis while the resulting outcome variable is placed on the vertical axis.
concepts.key_idea: Identify control input variables versus dependent response variables in linear variation graphs.
question_patterns: identify the independent variable in a relation between electricity and bill
which variable is plotted on the horizontal axis when graphing quantity against cost
determine whether quantity is a dependent or independent variable
verify if the graph passing through origin shows direct variation
explain which quantity controls the value of the other in a linear graph

solution_steps.explain: the quantity that can be set or changed independently is the independent variable on the x-axis
the quantity that changes as a direct result is the dependent variable on the y-axis

concepts.title: Direct Variation of Quantity and Cost
concepts.definition: When unit price remains uniform, the total cost of an item varies in direct proportion with the number of units purchased.
concepts.key_idea: Calculate total cost by multiplying unit price by quantity in linear cost relationships.
question_patterns: find the cost of {quantity} litres of petrol if 1 litre costs {unit_price} rupees
calculate the total price for {quantity} apples at unit price {unit_price}
what is the total cost for buying {quantity} units when each unit costs {unit_price}
compute the expenditure for {quantity} units given price per unit is {unit_price}
determine total cost when quantity is {quantity} and rate is {unit_price}

solution_steps.explain: total cost is the product of unit price and quantity

concepts.title: Simple Interest on Principal Deposit
concepts.definition: Simple interest accumulated over time is directly proportional to the principal sum deposited at a fixed percentage rate per annum.
concepts.key_idea: Calculate simple interest earned using principal amount, annual rate, and time in years.
question_patterns: find the annual simple interest for a deposit of {principal} rupees at rate {rate} percent
calculate simple interest on sum {principal} at {rate} percent for {time} years
what is the interest earned on {principal} rupees at rate {rate} over {time} year
compute simple interest for principal {principal} with interest rate {rate}
determine the annual interest obtainable for an investment of {principal} rupees at {rate} percent

solution_steps.explain: multiply principal, rate, and time, then divide by 100

concepts.title: Linear Distance Time Relationship at Uniform Speed
concepts.definition: When traveling at a uniform speed, distance covered increases linearly with time, expressed as the product of speed and duration.
concepts.key_idea: Calculate distance covered by multiplying constant speed by travel time.
question_patterns: find the distance covered in {time} hours at a constant speed of {speed} km per hour
calculate distance travelled when moving at speed {speed} km per hour for {time} hours
what is the distance covered by a vehicle travelling at {speed} km per hour in {time} hours
compute the total travel distance given speed {speed} km per hour and time {time} hours
determine distance reached in {time} hours at uniform speed {speed}

solution_steps.explain: distance is speed multiplied by time

concepts.title: Perimeter of Square as Linear Relation
concepts.definition: The total length around a square varies directly with its side length, forming a straight line graph.
concepts.key_idea: Calculate perimeter of a square by multiplying its side length by four.
question_patterns: find the perimeter of a square with side length {side} cm
calculate perimeter for a square having side {side} cm
what is the perimeter of a square of side {side} cm
compute the perimeter when square side is {side} cm
determine boundary length of a square with side {side} cm

solution_steps.explain: a square has four equal sides

concepts.title: Area of Square Non-Linear Relation
concepts.definition: The surface region enclosed by a square varies quadratically with its side length, generating a curved non-linear graph.
concepts.key_idea: Calculate area of a square by squaring its side length.
question_patterns: find the area of a square with side length {side} cm
calculate area for a square of side {side} cm
what is the area of a square having side {side} cm
compute square area given side length {side} cm
determine surface area of a square with side {side} cm

solution_steps.explain: area is side multiplied by itself
